meta.title: 60-Mile Radius Scan — Expansion Candidates
meta.question: Are there markets within 60 miles of any current MCTV market worth adding?
meta.method: Great-circle distance from every candidate to all five current markets; nearest wins. Distances are straight-line, not drive time.

candidates.name: Tuscaloosa + Northport, AL
candidates.note: 116,477 people plus ~34,000 University of Alabama students. The only genuine second Oxford inside the radius — and Oxford is our most proven build at 75 screens. Metro median household income $62,280; the city figure is depressed by students, exactly as it is in Oxford.
candidates.against: Contested. Impulse Digital Media already runs the same free-host model across Tuscaloosa and 40+ Alabama cities, Trillboards has 17 programmatic screens, and Lamar owns the outdoor. Also crosses a state line, needs its own rep, and 'MCTV of MS' does not travel.

candidates.name: Philadelphia, MS
candidates.note: The town is small, but Pearl River Resort next door runs three casinos, a hotel complex, a water park and a golf course on Choctaw tribal land, employing 2,400–3,000 people. MBCI operations carry roughly $1B in annual economic impact.
candidates.against: This is a destination play, not a town network — a handful of high-dwell screens serving visitors, not a 20-screen municipal build. Different sale, different math.

candidates.name: Grenada, MS
candidates.note: 12,335 people on the I-55 corridor, 44 miles from Oxford. The largest standalone town in the radius that we do not already touch.
candidates.against: Median household income $46,303 — well below Oxford or Tupelo. Modest advertiser base.

candidates.name: Corinth, MS
candidates.note: 48 miles from Tupelo, and the biggest town in the northeast corner.
candidates.against: Alcorn County shrank from 34,740 (2020) to 34,569 (2025). We already ruled it out in the territory brief; distance does not change that.

candidates.name: Holly Springs, MS
candidates.note: 28 miles from Oxford — the closest sizeable town we do not serve.
candidates.against: Declining at -1.83%/yr with a $45,462 median household income. Close is not the same as worth it.

candidates.name: Fulton, MS
candidates.note: 17 mi from Tupelo. Itawamba Community College.

candidates.name: Pontotoc, MS
candidates.note: 17 mi from Tupelo. Toyota Blue Springs nearby.

candidates.name: Booneville, MS
candidates.note: 29 mi from Tupelo. Northeast MS Community College.

outside.name: Clarksdale, MS
outside.note: 61 mi — just outside, and the Delta is losing population.

outside.name: Muscle Shoals, AL
outside.note: 68 mi from Tupelo. The Shoals is a real market — worth a look if the radius ever widens.

outside.name: Florence, AL
outside.note: 69 mi from Tupelo. University of North Alabama.
